messages.content: I'm planning a road trip from the Golden Gate Bridge in San Francisco (latitude 37.8199, longitude -122.4783) to the Hollywood Sign in Los Angeles (latitude 34.1341, longitude -118.3217). Can you find me the possible transportation routes using the Faretrotter API?

function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL to retrieve possible modes of transportation between two cities based on their geographical coordinates. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: The API endpoint for retrieving data.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the body of the request (used with POST and PUT requests).

Accept.description: Media type(s) that is/are acceptable for the response.

headers.description: Headers to include in the request as a dictionary of HTTP header names and values.

timeout.description: Time in seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up. This is a float type value.

auth.description: HTTP authentication credentials as a tuple (username, password).

cert.description: Path to the SSL certificate file.

cookies.description: Cookies to send with the request as a dictionary of cookie names and values.

http.description: URL of the proxy for HTTP connections.

https.description: URL of the proxy for HTTPS connections.

proxies.description: A dictionary mapping protocol or protocol and hostname to the URL of the proxy.

stream.description: If the response should be immediately downloaded (False) or streamed (True).

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate.

origin_lat.description: Latitude of the origin location in degrees. Value should be between -90.0 and 90.0. This is a float type value.

origin_lng.description: Longitude of the origin location in degrees. Value should be between -180.0 and 180.0. This is a float type value.

destination_lat.description: Latitude of the destination location in degrees. Value should be between -90.0 and 90.0. This is a float type value.

destination_lng.description: Longitude of the destination location in degrees. Value should be between -180.0 and 180.0. This is a float type value.
